{{Top|leg}}
The '''Meerian gesture of farewell''' was performed between two [[Meerian/Legends|Meerians]]&mdash;or a Meerian and another person&mdash;when an individual was leaving or saying good-bye. The gesture consisted of the individuals holding out their [[Limb/Legends|hands]], with their palms upward. Then, the hands would be flipped over, with the palms facing down.

==History==
The only known reference to this action was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] between the [[Meerian/Legends|Meerians]] [[VeerTa]] and [[SonTag]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. Although [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was present, he purposely didn't acknowledge the parting, because he thought no one seemed to care what he did.
